name: Author Content Ownership Transfer Workflow
description: Automatically transfers node ownership away from inactive users, with bulk tools and analytics.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Author Content Ownership Transfer Workflow 
 Author Content Ownership Transfer Workflow helps administrators to automatically and manually transfer content ownership from inactive users to active users. This ensures content continuity, improves editorial workflow management, and prevents orphaned content across the site.

 This module is especially useful for large editorial teams, multi-author platforms, and organizations where users frequently become inactive or leave.

 Back to top 

 Use Cases 
 This module is useful when:

 
 Authors leave the organization 
 Editorial accounts become inactive 
 Content ownership must be reassigned automatically 
 Site administrators manage large multi-author platforms 
 Content continuity must be maintained without manual cleanup 
 
 Back to top 

 How it works 
 The module monitors user inactivity and automatically transfers ownership of their content to a fallback user after a configurable number of inactive days.

Administrators can also manually transfer content between users from the administration interface.

Ownership transfer includes:

 
 Nodes 
 Comments (optional extension-ready support) 
 Files 
 Taxonomy 
 
 Back to top 

 Configuration 
 After enabling the module, configure settings at:

/admin/config/ownership-transfer-bulk

 Back to top
